scope_backlog.description: This is a finite initial inventory, not an exhaustive all-claimed tuple enumeration. Remaining positive vectors must be reconciled, not dropped or reclassified as exclusions. The 27-group registry is a source identity floor, not a tuple-completeness oracle.

Primary 8/16-region hard/softfp codegen rows are listed. Reconcile full C3FP runtime model NVIC/BASEPRI, lazy/eager, configuration and R9 vectors independently; r16 compile/link proof must not inherit r8 execution.

Reconcile actual C5TF ordinary/fixed-r9 execution rows using the model-probe NVIC result retained by the receipt. Do not invent that measured priority width from the initial nvic_bits=3 source value; existing scalar compile rows remain claimed.

Constructor R9 profiles CM33S-soft ordinary/fixed-r9 are NS-only proofs. Bind explicit Secure compiler and pool manifests before adding the paired exact tuples; never manufacture a standalone forward8 Secure companion.

Reconcile admitted actual-common BC/FC-origin execution and private capacity/stack-size manifests with the explicit NS/Secure pair. Baseline rows do not transfer object proof to other pool budgets or source generations.

Reconcile complete staged C55S NS/common dual-r9, four hash/map policies, attached/unattached and companion-budget vectors. RuntimeSelectable remains zero; raw compiler admission is not runtime activation or closed-reference parity.

Reconcile actual C3SO/C5SO consumer/archive/default-policy/dual-r9 execution tuples independently, including receipt-bound model priority widths. Both remain runtime-nonselectable despite compiler admission.

Reconcile remaining positive cohort-identity variants: service numbers, BASEPRI, hash/map/rewind, canary/redzone and exact compiler target spellings in maintained tests. Only listed positive vectors are candidates; do not generate all possible defines or silently merge materially different generated-code flags.
Reconcile remaining CM0/CM3/CM4/CM7 MPU CONTROL guard vectors and r9 variants. Listed classic MPU8/16 rows include header codegen only where referenced and do not imply full execution.
Seven-mode hard-FP CM4/CM7 execution does not establish softfp execution, complete panic suites, G0/M0+ execution or other classic protected runtime variants. Preserve those requirements.

The recorded four-ELF/88-pair lazy observer changes no production tuple. It does not cover all 32 MPU FP-grid images or strict low-FP/FPSCR self-selection; do not expand its selected-image receipt into global coverage.

F0/G0/G4/H7/H7S remain the priority. Bind real device/startup/linker/compiler manifests independently; AN500 r1p2 does not establish affected-r0p1 erratum effectiveness or H7/H7S board execution. No board hardware support is inferred.

All claimed exact tuples still require five paired object modes and seven final-image mode keys, including genuine final executable O2/Os LTO inspection. This inventory and native relocatable LTO receipts are not that proof.

Pinned tool/reference identities, exact source/workflow SHA, required architecture execution and retained complete artifacts remain release-blocking work. No inventory validation result is CI or qualification evidence.

Staged M33 scalar-FP SecureContext construction/initializer sources are outside the admitted 27-group registry. Complete runtime, allocation/load/save, FP/Secure switching and exact paired manifests remain pending; do not add a null-ID claimed group.
M33 scalar and scalar-FP MPU SecureContext pairs require exact paired protected manifests and their own processor-state and privilege proofs.
M55 scalar-FP and MVE-FP Non-secure/Secure companion tuples remain pending; scalar C55S does not cover them.
M55 scalar, scalar-FP and MVE-FP MPU SecureContext pairs require distinct protected manifests; existing no-companion MPU groups do not cover them.
M33/M55 protected and FP/MVE Secure-only scheduler manifests remain pending. Scalar staged Secure-only sources are not companion artifacts and do not cover these extensions.
Additional M33 protected and M55 FP/MVE/protected TF-M tuples remain unresolved or unimplemented. Typed NS fixtures do not establish real external TF-M Secure-image/PSA integration.
Exact architectural/compiler/security tuple inclusion and PAC/BTI save/restore remain unresolved; current rejection is not a roadmap exclusion.
MVE=integer/FPU=0 inclusion and exact reference/compiler/security/MPU tuple remain unresolved, not covered by MVE-FP.
M85/STM32V8 remains conditional scope requiring an explicit admission or deferral decision and matching exact tuples; not a permanent ReferenceOnly exclusion.

Additional M23 Secure-only/companion roles remain reference-portability candidates unless an STM32 target is admitted. Existing implemented M23 NTZ rows stay Claimed software rows, not silently excluded.
Reference directory presence does not create an STM32 support claim or another implemented cohort; exact target admission is separate.
IAR/Arm Compiler directories are not extra CPU profiles; materially different compiler ABI/generated-state claims require separate pinned evidence.
